body:
## Changes

- Adds a **Previous Editions** separator and **LM4Sci 2025** link to the left-sidebar on all `/docs/2026/*` pages via `src/content/2026/_meta.js`.
- The navbar "Workshop Details" link was already corrected to `/docs/2026` in a prior commit; no change needed there.

## Why

Visitors browsing the 2026 workshop docs now have a clear path to the archived 2025 edition from the sidebar, without clutter in the main navigation items.

Closes #9
title: Add Previous Editions sidebar section linking to LM4Sci 2025
